chars.name: 태종
chars.look: Joseon king Taejong in 1411, strong-built man in his mid 40s, stern commanding face, thick black beard and mustache, wearing the bright crimson-red royal robe

chars.name: 이우
chars.look: former Joseon official Yi U, man in his 50s, proud mocking face, thin grey-streaked beard, wearing a pale sky-blue long overcoat with a thin black sash

chars.name: 관찰사
chars.look: Joseon provincial governor, man in his 50s, worried tired face, short black beard, wearing the deep blue-green official robe

chars.name: 코끼리 사육 하인
chars.look: Joseon low-ranking stable servant, man in his 30s, simple honest face, hair in a topknot under a cloth headband, rough off-white hemp clothes with rolled sleeves, straw shoes, no hat

chars.name: 일본 사신
chars.look: Japanese envoy of the Muromachi period around 1411, man in his 40s, dignified face, black lacquered tall eboshi hat, dark blue hitatare formal robe with wide sleeves and long hakama trousers, holding a folded fan

chars.name: 코끼리
chars.look: Asian elephant, adult male, grey wrinkled skin, small rounded ears, short tusks, long trunk, gentle but sad eyes, slightly thin body
